reviews.comment: I took FINC 371 online over the summer and it was very educational, while being not very difficult or much of a time commitment.

Dr Peterson is very nice! You show up to class once a week, listen to a guest lecturer, and then take an attendance quiz. Very easy class if you just show up. Short reflection paper at the end of the year.

UNPROFESSIONAL PROFESSOR! Get ready to read the WHOLE textbook & ONLY learn from the textbook. He doesn't explain the material, only read the slides. Always arrived late, no time respect for students. Quiz for each chapter & 3 exams (facts given in class on the test).Canceled class 3 times & rushed through half of the material for a test in 1 class
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Easiest class ever. Just go to class once a week and take a 1-question quiz at the end. Class consists of different guest speakers each week. A short reflection paper due at end of semester. He offers one extra credit opportunity at the beginning of the semester that you should totally do because it will give you leeway to miss a few classes.

Literally the easiest class ever. It's only a 1hr credit class that is just guest speakers each class. Attendance is mandatory however. No work at all with only a 1-3pg self reflection at end of semester. If you need this class as a credit for Finance, definitely take with him since its so easy and free.
Weekly quizzes on Canvas. 3 exams including the final. Quizzes worth 15% of your grade everything else exams. Curved the class around 2 points at the end.

Dr. Peterson is easily one of my favorite professors I've ever had. He gave great and funny lectures and was very caring and engaging. The course is very interesting if you have any interest in real estate. It is super broad but teaches you so much, especially if you ever plan on buying a house one day.

Peterson is my favorite professor. He engages the class and brings materials to class for us to look at. He adds little jokes to his lectures which I enjoy and he is very clear. I think real estate is super interesting and he helps the class be interesting. Exams are tough but if you study the slides, you should do okay. I highly recommend him.

Funny guy but just think this class is not interesting at all. 3 Exams with the first 2 being 25% and the final being 35% (cumulative). Exams are mostly from his slides with little math on them. Class isn't TOO hard but definitely think you could find better/more interesting electives.
